EDK2 UEFI Shell 2.2 (edk2-stable202002), x64 - vendored for Universal Service OS

Shell.efi      unmodified ShellBinPkg/UefiShell/X64/Shell.efi from the official
               TianoCore release asset
               https://github.com/tianocore/edk2/releases/download/edk2-stable202002/ShellBinPkg.zip
               (zip SHA-256 d6876ef9b9a48ca612149b888d4f4e923d1b8ccf495b8f6f6c3f83defb40b56a)
License.txt    License.txt of the same tag (BSD-2-Clause-Patent)
               https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tianocore/edk2/edk2-stable202002/License.txt

Source code:   https://github.com/tianocore/edk2/tree/edk2-stable202002/ShellPkg
               tag edk2-stable202002 = commit 4c0f6e349d32cf27a7104ddd3e729d6ebc88ea70

edk2-stable202002 is the last EDK2 stable tag with an official prebuilt Shell
(ShellBinPkg.zip); later releases publish sources only.

Refetch and verify: powershell -File tools/fetch_uefi_shell.ps1
(downloads the zip, checks the zip and file hashes against manifest.json).

At release (installer/cmd/usos-efisign release) the file is copied
hash-checked to EFI/USOS/shell/Shell.efi and, when the USOS key is present,
gets the USOS MOK signature (an Authenticode certificate table is appended;
the image itself is not changed). License.txt and this file
go next to it on the ESP.
